items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections in one frame: header rows on shared keylines, panels unfold from the header's keyline; one or many open.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: Installs the dialog item, which exports AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogPopup and AlertDialogContent (focus on the safe action, destructive or primary tone) beside Dialog. Import from dialog.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Header frame (navigation toggle, breadcrumb, actions), a sidebar, the page and an aside, one gutter apart; the sidebar is a full-height column that can collapse to a rail; below a width of its own the sidebar and aside become sheets.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file as a frame of cells that never change: media, name (the extension stays in view) and detail, one action. Uploading fills the bottom keyline; processing runs the pending segment; error stops the bar in red and floods the media cell with !; an upload that lands floods it yellow with a tick for 900ms. layout="cell" makes it a cell of a Bubble.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or organisation as a square cell (Base UI Avatar): the photo rises in from the bottom keyline, initials hold the cell while it loads or after it fails, status as its floor keyline (a line shape per kind, never over the face); AvatarGroup joins avatars on shared seams with a +N count cell.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where a page sits: ancestor link cells and a cobalt cell for here; earlier levels fold into a menu by count or width.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: One message as a control-weight frame (2px, no radius) holding cells: the text, then files (Attachment layout="cell"). Consecutive bubbles attach on a 1px seam. Tone by role: plain (theirs), tint (yours), attention (not sent: the attention frame and an inserted ! cell). pending runs the Signal segment on the bottom keyline while it sends. Reactions sit on the bottom keyline.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Framed button with affix cells, key travel and pending/done/failed signals.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons attached in one control frame: Button cells on shared seams, each its own Tab stop; text cells and a heavier separator; horizontal or vertical. Toolbar is the one-Tab-stop row; SplitButton the action with its menu.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar logic
items.description: Pure range helpers: ordering, available-day count and locale-aware range formatting. The grid and keyboard are react-day-picker's.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides on Embla, as the reference: a frame of slides on travelling 1px seams with a control row of cells (previous, n / N with position ticks, next). APG carousel without rotation: named region, slides labelled n of N, out-of-view slides inert, arrow keys mirrored in RTL, moves announced politely, instant steps under reduced motion.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Charts on recharts, as the reference: series colours by role from the data tokens (focal, comparison, rest, mark, alert) as --color-<key>; solid hairline grid, Code-voice ticks, square marks and keys, an inverse tooltip with tabular figures. ChartFigure adds a title and a Chart / Table switch over the same rows. RTL axes and reduced motion are applied for you.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Square check box and a labelled checkbox row with description; indeterminate supported.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox group
items.description: Several independent choices to one question in one frame (Base UI CheckboxGroup): an optional parent row that checks or clears all with a count, rows with description and meta, Form participant.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One unframed disclosure: a caret box whose keyline runs down the panel as a spine; the panel unfolds.

items.name: collection
items.title: Collection helpers
items.description: Pure helpers: the sort cycle of a column header, a numeric-aware locale comparator, and the constant-width window of page numbers.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Single-value combobox: a Select you can type into. Local filtering or an async source (abort, status, retry), optional groups; the list docks to the frame.

items.name: command
items.title: Command menu
items.description: ⌘K command menu: digit cells run by index, grouped results, empty state.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: Menu opened on an object (right-click, long-press, Menu key): Menu's rows and submenus; marks the object while open.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: TanStack Table driving the Keyline table parts: useDataTable (sorting, multi-sort, filters, a search, paging, row selection, column visibility; each slice controlled or not) and DataTable, DataTableBulkBar, DataTablePagination and DataTableSearch. Selecting a row re-renders that row alone.

items.name: data-table-model
items.title: Data table model
items.description: Pure helpers behind the Data Table: the sort cycle and multi-sort ordinal of a column, aria-sort, a column's alignment, the pager's range, and the filter model (text, set and range filters, a search, and the filter's words for a token).

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: Single-date calendar and picker on react-day-picker, sharing the range calendar's look, wording and bounds; the chosen day floods ink. DateTimePicker adds a time row (a TimeField cell, 24- or 12-hour, with optional minTime/maxTime) under the calendar.

items.name: date-range
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: Range calendar on react-day-picker (pinned) styled as a Keyline grid: a flooded range with ink ends, row-break notches, hover and keyboard preview, hatched unavailable days, month and year dropdowns, min/max, presets and a day count.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog (header, scrolling body, footer cells) and AlertDialog (an attention cell; focus lands on the safe action): region-framed modals on Base UI. Also installable as @keyline-ui/alert-dialog.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: DirectionProvider: sets a subtree's writing direction for both the DOM (Keyline's CSS and DOM-reading components) and Base UI (the sides tooltips, popovers and menus take; arrow keys). useDirection reads it.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A sheet you swipe away, on Base UI Drawer as the reference: swipe with velocity, snap points, nested drawers, focus trap, Escape and the keyboard inset are the library's. Keyline: the page-facing edge at region weight, a grip on it, logical sides (end and start mirror in RTL), the system's motion timings.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Nothing here, said plainly: a count cell, the message and the way out, in one frame or as a cell. Empty, error and first-use kinds.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Field, input, affix cells, field group and validation with an inserted attention cell. Form (Base UI Form) and vertical, horizontal or responsive field orientation.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A link that previews its destination (Base UI Preview Card): the underline draws along its keyline during the open delay; the card is a control frame of cells (media, title, code, facts on seams) one gutter from the link. Supplementary content only.

items.name: inspector
items.title: Inspector
items.description: Non-modal contextual panel: header with the inspected object's code, key/value cells and a sticky action strip.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: List rows on shared keylines: media cell, content, meta and action cells; render-prop rows for links and buttons.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key in the Code voice: a key cell with a 2px floor; KbdGroup joins a chord's keys on seams (nested kbd), with the separator read, not drawn. Used by Command.

items.name: keyline
items.title: Keyline
items.description: Keyline tokens and construction primitives: role weights, the optional cut (--kl-cut), cells, flood, lamp, unfold, dock, pending. Source tokens go to your :root and .dark; theme/tokens.ts holds them as data.
items.docs: Shape: square by default (--kl-cut: 0). Set --kl-cut to 0.5 (quiet) or 1 (full) on :root or any subtree for the cut accent, or use data-kl-cut="quiet" | "on" | "off". Density: data-kl-density="compact". Reduced motion: honours prefers-reduced-motion; data-kl-motion="reduce" forces it.

light.kl-font: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

:root, .light, .dark, [data-kl-config].--kl-yellow: oklch(from var(--kl-working) calc(l - 0.04 * var(--kl-dark)) calc(c * (1 - 0.06 * var(--kl-dark))) h)
:root, .light, .dark, [data-kl-config].--kl-data-2: oklch(from var(--kl-cobalt) calc(l + 0.18 + 0.02 * var(--kl-dark)) calc(c * 0.5) h)
:root, .light, .dark, [data-kl-config].--kl-hatch:
repeating-linear-gradient(
      -45deg,
      transparent 0 5px,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--kl-ink) 14%, transparent) 5px 6px
    )

.kl-frame, .kl-ctl.clip-path:
polygon(
        calc(var(--kl-c) + var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(var(--kl-c) + var(--kl-o))
      )

.kl-frame:is([dir=\"rtl\"], [dir=\"rtl\".clip-path:
polygon(
        calc(100% - var(--kl-c) - var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(var(--kl-c) + var(--kl-o))
      )

.kl-flood:is( [data-kl-on], :not([data-k.transition:
background-color 0s linear var(--kl-t-flood),
      color 0s linear calc(var(--kl-t-flood) * 0.4)

items.name: keyline-config
items.title: Keyline configuration
items.description: The configuration contract as data: palette presets, fonts, weights, cut, density, theme, motion. Generates the CSS, attributes and registry item a configuration needs, and a runtime KeylineConfigScope.

items.name: keyline-motion
items.title: Keyline motion
items.description: Flood origin, zero-bounce stretch springs and the useStretch hook. No runtime provider.

items.name: keyline-render
items.title: Keyline render helpers
items.description: Merge Keyline's classes and styles with a className or style given as a function of state, and mirror variant props to data attributes.

items.name: keyline-scope
items.title: Keyline portal scope
items.description: Carries subtree configuration (palette, font, weights, cut, density, motion, theme, dir) onto portaled overlays. No provider.

items.name: keyline-shadcn
items.title: Keyline for the whole app (opt-in)
items.description: Maps shadcn's semantic tokens, radius, fonts, focus ring and page body to Keyline, so stock shadcn components take Keyline's look. Not needed to use Keyline components.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A step in a conversation or activity timeline in the Code voice: a glyph cell and words, a separator between seams, or a keyline under the words; pending runs the pending segment and is a polite status.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Docked menu with code cells, shortcut cells, ink cursor, destructive rows, checkbox and radio items, and submenus.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A row of menus in one frame (Base UI Menubar): title key cells, the open title inverse, menus docked to the frame's edge with Menu's rows and checkbox and radio items.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A sender's run in a conversation, on one reading edge: the header (name, time), every bubble's text, the file glyphs and the receipt start on the same line. Consecutive bubbles stack on shared keylines; the avatar sits in the gutter level with the first bubble. align="end" is the reader's own run, at the end of the log, mirrored with the writing direction.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message scroller
items.description: A conversation log on @shadcn/react's MessageScroller, as the reference: stays on the newest message, holds the reader's place when scrolled up, keeps position when older messages are prepended; role=log inside a focusable region. Keyline adds: the place also holds when content above changes size (in every engine), arrivals unfold from their top keyline while the reader follows, and a Latest cell that counts what arrived below and jumps a bounded, interruptible distance. The log scrolls inside Keyline's Scroll Area, so its bar is the shared one; the jump reveals it, and pressing it is the reader taking over.

items.name: multiselect
items.title: Multiselect
items.description: Searchable async multiselect, a preset over Combobox's parts with Base UI's multiple: chips are cells in the field frame, the list docks to it.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: The platform's own select in a Keyline field frame: the caret cell drawn over its end, the OS list in the page's scheme, options or groups, a Field participant (name, required, validate, Form errors).

items.name: nav
items.title: Nav
items.description: Vertical (or wrapping) location list; the cobalt band stretches between items. Labelled groups, icon key cells, nested links under a disclosure, row actions (NavAction), a brand identity block and a footer; a rail of key cells with tooltips inside AppShell. With AppShell it is the sidebar (@keyline-ui/sidebar).

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Site navigation (Base UI Navigation Menu): a control frame of section triggers and links, the open trigger inverse, the current page cobalt; each section's panel docks to the frame's keyline with link cells on shared seams (title, description, code).

items.name: notice
items.title: Notice
items.description: Inline message: a tone cell with a glyph, the message, and action cells; folds away; narrow layout drops actions to their own row.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A number in a field frame with stepper key cells and a unit cell: Base UI NumberField (locale parsing, hold-to-repeat, min/max) inside a Field.

items.name: options
items.title: Option and value helpers
items.description: Pure helpers: group options under headings in first-appearance order, and the longest value a numeric scale prints.

items.name: otp-field
items.title: OTP field
items.description: A one-time code in one field frame (Base UI OTP Field): a cell per character on shared seams, groups split by a join cell, paste and SMS autofill, a Field participant; verification signals pending, done and failed in the frame.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page numbers as cells with a cobalt current page; constant width while paging; folds to "5 / 20" when narrow; buttons or links.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: Region frame with header, body and footer cells; PanelGrid joins panels into one frame with shared keylines.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Arbitrary content docked to its trigger (or detached by one gutter), with optional header, body and footer cells.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Task progress: the pending signal made determinate (yellow fill, ink leading edge), indeterminate, complete and failed states.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A multi-step form on @shadcn/react's Questionnaire, as the reference: single choice (the radio group's rows and ink band), multiple choice (checkbox rows), free text (the field frame), required and optional steps, Back, Skip, Next and Submit as Button cells, answers kept when going back, errors described on the current step, focus on the new step's heading, Progress for the step.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Exclusive choice as framed rows; the ink band stretches to the chosen row.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels that share a seam you can move, on react-resizable-panels v4: the 1px seam is the handle, thickening to 3px ink on hover or drag and drawn in the focus colour on keyboard focus; an optional grip cell. Keys, collapse, reset, touch targets and persistence are the library's.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A native scroll container with Keyline scrollbars (Base UI Scroll Area): a bar is a cell on the region's edge, owning its seam; content is padded only while an axis overflows; corner cell for both bars; focusable viewport with an inset ring. The thumb reveals while its axis scrolls and when the pointer is on the bar, widens and darkens there, inks while held, then fades (overlay platforms; always shown where native bars take space, in forced colours and for more contrast).
items.docs: Size the root (height or max-height) with your own class: <ScrollArea className="h-64" label="Activity">…</ScrollArea>. scrollbars="vertical" (default), "horizontal" or "both". Scrolling stays native (wheel, trackpad, touch, keyboard). Give label when nothing else names the region; the viewport is focusable while it overflows. Do not wrap Select or Multiselect lists in it: they keep their own native scroller, styled to match.

items.name: scroll-edges
items.title: Scroll edges
items.description: Marks the edge of a sideways-scrolling cell row where items are hidden (data-kl-more); the theme casts an ink shadow inward from that edge.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Exclusive choice in one frame; the ink band stretches between cells.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Single select: field-frame trigger with a caret cell; the list docks to the frame. Options form (with groups) or parts named as Base UI names them (SelectRoot, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectPopup, SelectItem, SelectGroup, SelectSeparator …).

items.name: selection
items.title: Selection scope
items.description: Pure helpers and a hook for page / all-matching selection with hidden-row accounting, plus snapshot-based undo.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A region docked to a viewport edge (end, start, bottom): Base UI Dialog behaviour, unfolds from its edge, cut on the inner corner.

items.name: shipments-demo
items.title: Shipments (demo block)
items.description: A working application composition: filterable, selectable table with expanded detail, inspector, bulk actions with undo.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar (AppShell + Nav)
items.description: Installs the sidebar: AppShell (the column, its toggle, collapse to an icon rail, a start sheet on narrow layouts) and Nav (groups, icon keys, nested links, row actions, identity and footer). Import from app-shell and nav.
items.docs: <AppShell collapse="rail" nav={<Nav layout="cell" groups={…} value={…} onValueChange={…} />}>…</AppShell>. Nested links: an item with items: [...]. Row actions: action: <Menu><MenuTrigger render={<NavAction label="More for …" />} />…</Menu>.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder for content on its way: the table's loading cell outside the table, in line, block, value and control shapes; a busy group that names what is loading.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A continuous or stepped value (or a range) in one control frame: the Meter's rail with an ink fill, a 2px thumb with a grip keyline, and a readout cell sized for the longest value.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split button
items.description: One control frame, two cells: the action and its menu. The menu docks to the frame.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: Count voice with label, unit, delta signal and an optional meter.

items.name: status
items.title: Status and badge
items.description: Status glyph + text (shape survives forced colours); square code badge.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Binary setting: a two-cell frame whose block stretches to the on side.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Presentational table parts on utilities: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption, TableSortHeader, TableBulkBar and TablePager, each with render and a className that may be a function of its state, plus the frame's views, toolbar, index column, expanded detail, empty/error rows and pagination. No part holds state.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a cobalt location band that stretches; optional count voice; panels.

items.name: time-field
items.title: Time field
items.description: A time of day in one field frame: hour and minute spin-button cells that wrap, a day-period cell on a 12-hour clock, a zone affix, optional min/max bounds; the 24-hour "HH:MM" value reaches Base UI Form and FormData.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Actionable feedback on Base UI Toast that docks into a host cell or floats at the inline-end corner: done, failed, info, warning and loading kinds, a description line, one action (Undo, Retry), the countdown draining the keyline. useToaster() and createToaster() add promise tracking, update and dismiss, and calls from outside React.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: One on/off button (Base UI Toggle, aria-pressed): pressed floods yellow and fills the lamp; icon toggles show a floor keyline. Control or cell, alone or as a cell of a field frame. ToggleGroup composes its cells.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Independent toggles in one frame; each cell floods from the press point and carries a lamp.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of commands that is one Tab stop (Base UI Toolbar): item cells on shared seams, groups on a 2px keyline, toggles that flood, an exclusive group whose ink band stretches, menus docked to the frame, a text input cell; horizontal or vertical.

items.name: toolbar-overflow
items.title: Toolbar overflow
items.description: Pure logic behind Toolbar's overflow menu: items identified by data-slot, which leave for a given count, where More goes, and one step of the fit (with its sub-pixel rule).

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Ink label docked to the focus ring of its trigger, with an optional shortcut cell. Never cut.
